related.description: Google Reader inspired self-hosted personal RSS reader.
A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
An irrationally minimalist, static feed reader (RSS, Atom, JSON) you can instantly deploy on Netlify, Glitch or your own server.
multipurpose rss reader, live stream, mashup, aggregation web application
RSS reader for macOS and iOS.
